utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still catching up, but I’ll check the exact list and timing for the repair drive and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—just send me the list and timing when you have it, and I’ll keep an eye on what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’m checking the list and timing now, and I’ll send you both as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli — I’m still pinning down the exact drop-off spot for the repair supplies and kits, but it’ll be at the front porch this Saturday. Once I confirm the setup, I’ll point everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal — I’ll watch for the porch drop-off on Saturday and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli — that’s a huge help. I’ll confirm the porch setup and let you know where to put the supplies as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, can you ask around for the list and let me know who I should talk to?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — I can ask around and see who’s fixing what, then pass it along to you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. Let me know who’s handling each repair so I can follow up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Lamp and fence board first—if you can help, great. We’ll keep the rest quick.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can help with that. I’ll check who’s around and let you know if we need more hands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Bring anyone available, and I’ll start on the lamp.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—did the repair drive get enough help?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We’re still a little short, so any extra hands or supplies would really help. I’m lining up the last bits for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help spread the word while I’m out running errands, and I’ll check if anyone’s got extra supplies. Hope you get those last bits lined up by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can still help sort the donated items and mark what works, but keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ll keep it quick and bring the hammer and screwdriver by your porch today.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks—just drop them by, and I’ll sort them when I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — I’m still figuring out the list, but if you stop by later, I can show you what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can stop by later and take a look. Just let me know what needs fixing when you're ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks—I'll sort the list and show you when you come by later. Appreciate you helping out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’m still pinning down the time, but I’ll send it over as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Mara — just send the time when you have it and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do — I’ll message you as soon as I lock in the time. Thanks again for being flexible.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We’re still short on screws, duct tape, batteries, and a few hand tools. If you can bring anything, I’ll help keep track so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia—I'll round up what I can and make sure we keep track of the rest. Since it’s now Sunday at the community center, I’ll also let everyone know the updated details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa—just please keep the list handy so we don’t miss anything. I’ll check back later today to see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still piecing together the repair list, but I can help keep things moving if you want to check with folks for any last items.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a big help—I'll check with folks for any last items and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Sam—send me anything new and I’ll help slot it in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, thanks, Kira. I could use one more person at the front porch this Saturday, and if you can help sort tools or greet folks, that would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes — I’m definitely in for the repair drive. I can help at the front porch this Saturday and greet folks too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s perfect, Kira—thank you. I’ll put you at the front porch this Saturday to greet folks and help sort tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details and make sure you’re added for the repair drive. Thanks for helping spread the word too!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll wait for the details before I commit so I can see exactly what still needs doing and when it’s scheduled.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll send over the details right away so you can take a look, and then you can let me know if you’re in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I commit, can you tell me exactly what the repair drive still needs and when it’s happening?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s this Saturday at the front porch, and I still need a couple of helpers for setup, sorting, and greeting people. I’m glad to have you if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I can probably do it, but I’d like to check one thing—what time on Saturday should I plan for?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I still need a few helpers and the basic repair supplies. Once I know the exact time, I can work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—how many helpers do you need, and what supplies should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s going slowly, but it’s moving along. I can cover a few things, and I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — I’m a little scattered, so keep me posted and I can help where I can on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do, Noah. I’ll send you an update before Saturday so you know what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Oren—looks like we still need tape, a level, and some wood glue if you can find them. I’ll keep track of the rest.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I can hunt down the tape, a level, and some wood glue. Just tell me when and where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—drop them by my porch tomorrow afternoon, and I’ll make sure they get to the repair drive. Thanks, Oren!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll make sure you’re added right away. If you can, please spread the word to a few neighbors about bringing tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can spread the word to a few neighbors about bringing tools or spare parts. Do you have a short list of what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes — we still need basic hand tools, spare screws and nails, tape, and any small replacement parts people can spare. I’ll send around the full list too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We still need a few extra tools and some sturdy supplies for Saturday—if you’ve got anything handy, bring it by the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll check what I’ve got at home and bring anything useful by the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Dane—that’d be a big help. Just drop by the front porch on Saturday, and I’ll sort it all out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — once you send the updated list, I’ll compare it with what I’ve got and only bring what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll send the updated list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks, Leo. I’ll wait for the list before I pack anything up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey. I’m still pinning down the exact spot for the drop-off supplies and repair kits at the front porch, and I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — just let me know where to bring things once it’s set. I can help point folks to the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I really appreciate that. I’ll send you the exact porch spot as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m still a bit behind on the details — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still keeping folks posted, and if anything changes I’ll pass it along. Let me know the list once you have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the exact list too, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m organizing the details. What supplies or help should we prioritize first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s start with tools, tape, and a few volunteers to sort and carry things. I’ll make a simple list so we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Eli—tools, tape, and a few volunteers to sort and carry things sound like the right start. Send me your list, and I’ll line up the help for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet—did the repair drive get enough help?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re definitely in for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I’m in—did you get enough help for it?
